algorithm: Merge sorted empirical distributions to compute maximum CDF distance. Train logistic regression with batch gradient descent. Promote only when held-out accuracy meets .7 and does not fall below the existing model on the same holdout.
architecture: Incoming batch → cleaning/missingness → KS and accuracy monitor → policy → isolated trainer → held-out gate → atomic registry.
data_model: Rows = numeric feature and binary label. Monitor output records sample counts, D statistic, approximate threshold, trigger, job and promotion decisions.
description: Distribution monitoring, quality gates and isolated local retraining with holdout-controlled model promotion.
design: Missingness stops automatic training rather than silently learning from badly corrupted inputs. Label changes can trigger retraining independently of feature drift. Cloud adapter design is documented separately.
family_notes: Observe sampling variation on the reference distribution.
Shift the feature mean and check the KS monitor.
Increase feature variance and test drift detection.
Reject batches with too many missing values from retraining.
Detect performance degradation even with unchanged feature distribution.
Use a minimum-sample policy and disable automatic retraining for this diagnostic profile.
limitations: No cloud jobs, MLflow service or production metrics backend. KS threshold is approximate, not an exact p-value, and repeated testing requires false-alarm control. The reference is a one-feature classifier. Holdout sets are small; promotion accuracy is illustrative, not a clinical or business acceptance standard.
operations: Use trusted batches only. Track drift windows and delayed labels. The subprocess is job separation, not a security sandbox. Cloud credentials and service provisioning are intentionally not assumed.
scope: Two-sample KS statistic, asymptotic threshold, missingness gate, simple logistic training in a subprocess, held-out accuracy comparison and checksummed atomic local registry.
security: Treat this as educational code; review it before handling trusted data.
title: Self-Healing MLOps Pipeline
